name: Strength set logging
definition: Log weight and reps for each set of a lift during a live workout.

name: Start an empty workout
definition: Start an unplanned workout and add exercises as you go.

name: Previous performance shown or pre-filled
definition: While logging, each set shows or pre-fills what you lifted last time on that exercise.
aspects: Copy sets from a past session

name: Live comparison during a workout
definition: During a workout, running totals or a live comparison against previous sessions are shown.

name: Effort per set (RPE / RIR)
definition: Record perceived exertion or reps in reserve for a set or exercise.

name: Whole-workout effort rating
definition: Rate how hard an entire session felt.

name: Lifting tempo tracking
definition: Record the tempo of a set.

name: Complete planned sets without entering each
definition: Mark a planned workout, group or all remaining sets as done as prescribed instead of entering every set.

name: Workout name and notes
definition: Give a workout a name and attach a free-text note or description.

name: Photos or video on a workout
definition: Attach photos or video to a logged workout.

name: Add and reorder exercises mid-workout
definition: Add exercises to, or drag to reorder exercises within, a workout in progress.

name: Exercise swap with suggested alternatives
definition: Replace an exercise mid-workout, with the app suggesting suitable alternatives.

name: Exercise notes
definition: Attach a note to an exercise, kept with the session or shown next time.

name: Grip and attachment tracking
definition: Record the grip, handle or attachment used, with history kept per grip.

name: Bodyweight, weighted and assisted exercises
definition: Exercises that use body weight, including added load or assistance, are logged and counted correctly.

name: Timed exercises
definition: Log time-based exercises (e.g. planks) by duration, with a timer.

name: Pause, resume or discard a workout
definition: Pause the workout clock and resume later, or throw away a workout in progress.

name: Edit or delete past workouts
definition: Change or delete a workout after it has been saved.
aspects: Delete a workout or one activity

name: Log a workout after the fact
definition: Record a workout you did earlier, on its real date and time.

name: Search workout history
definition: Search or filter the list of past workouts.

name: Forgotten-workout reminder
definition: Prompts you when a workout appears abandoned (inactivity or leaving the location).

name: Offline logging
definition: Workouts can be logged and saved without a connection and sync later.

name: Kilograms and pounds
definition: Choose kilograms or pounds as the weight unit.

name: Per-exercise weight units
definition: Use a different weight unit for an individual exercise or piece of equipment.

name: Keep screen awake during workouts
definition: Option to stop the phone locking during a workout.

name: Rest timer
definition: A countdown (or count-up) between sets, typically starting when a set is completed.

name: Custom rest per exercise or set
definition: Set different rest durations per exercise or per set, remembered next time.

name: Rest-end alerts
definition: A sound, vibration, voice cue or notification when rest is over.

name: Warm-up set tagging
definition: Mark sets as warm-ups (kept separate from working sets).

name: Automatic warm-up sets
definition: The app inserts warm-up sets with calculated weights before working sets.

name: Drop sets
definition: Log a set as a drop set with reduced-weight follow-on efforts.
aspects: Rest timer skipped before drop sets

name: Failure sets
definition: Mark a set as taken to failure.

name: Additional set types (top set, partials, cool-down)
definition: Set-type tags beyond warm-up, drop and failure, such as top sets, partial reps or cool-down sets.

name: Supersets
definition: Group two exercises to be performed back-to-back.

name: Giant sets and circuits
definition: Group three or more exercises together as a giant set or circuit.

name: Per-set rep targets and pyramids
definition: Templates can hold rep ranges or different targets per set (pyramids, reverse pyramids).

name: Plate calculator
definition: Shows which plates to load for a target weight.

name: Saved workout templates
definition: Save reusable workouts and start a session from one.

name: Template folders or tags
definition: Organise templates into folders or tags.

name: Repeat a past workout or save it as a template
definition: Turn a completed workout into a template, or start a new session copied from it.

name: Update template from a workout
definition: After a workout that changed, choose to write the changes back into its template.

name: Per-template progress
definition: A template shows its past runs or a progress trend.

name: Ready-made single workouts
definition: A library of pre-built single sessions to start from.

name: Ready-made programs and splits
definition: A library of pre-built multi-day programs or weekly splits.

name: Programs from named coaches
definition: Structured plans authored by named coaches or creators, with their own content.

name: Custom split builder
definition: Build your own multi-day split or weekly plan by hand.

name: Planning calendar
definition: Schedule workouts on future dates in a calendar, and see planned against completed.

name: Workout history calendar
definition: A calendar or grid view of days you trained.

name: Workout reminders
definition: Notifications reminding you to train (scheduled or after inactivity).

name: Apple Calendar sync
definition: Planned workouts appear in the system calendar.

name: Generated training program
definition: The app builds a personalised multi-day program from your goals, schedule and equipment.
aspects: Start any workout of the week

name: Generated single workout
definition: The app generates a personalised workout on demand (today's session).

name: Automatic progressive overload
definition: The app recommends when and how much to increase weight or reps based on your performance.
aspects: Conservative starting estimates for new users

name: Progression on repeated templates
definition: Saved workouts can be re-run with automatically progressed sets, reps or weights.

name: Recovery-driven workout selection
definition: The next workout's muscles are chosen from estimated per-muscle recovery.

name: Automatically generated supersets
definition: Generated workouts can group exercises into supersets or circuits automatically.

name: Exercise exclusions and preferences
definition: Exclude exercises (or muscles) from recommendations, or ask for some more often.

name: Injury-aware programming
definition: Record injuries or painful movements and recommendations avoid or substitute aggravating exercises.

name: Gym equipment profiles
definition: Saved gym/equipment profiles restrict recommended exercises to what you have.

name: Available weights and increments
definition: Tell the app which dumbbells, plates or machine increments you have so suggestions are loadable.

name: Periodization (deloads, phases, test days)
definition: Planned variation over weeks: deload periods, phased progressions or max-effort test days.

name: Regenerate today's workout
definition: Ask for a new version of a generated workout.

name: Weekly set targets per muscle
definition: Recommended weekly working-set ranges per muscle, with progress against them.

name: AI coach chat
definition: A conversational AI coach inside the app that answers using your own training data.

name: AI-written training summaries
definition: AI-written plain-language summaries of a workout or a training week.

name: Form analysis from video
definition: Record or upload a video of a set and get a form score or feedback.
aspects: Form score history and friend leaderboard

name: AI progress-photo analysis
definition: AI commentary on progress photos.

name: AI-filled custom exercises
definition: AI fills in a custom exercise's details from its name or a video link.

name: ChatGPT / Claude / MCP integration
definition: Connect external AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, MCP clients) to your training data.

name: Voice logging
definition: Log sets, workouts or plans by speaking.

name: Head-gesture logging
definition: Log sets hands-free with head gestures through headphones.

name: Built-in exercise library
definition: A built-in catalogue of exercises (size as stated by the app).

name: Exercise demonstration videos or animations
definition: Each exercise has a video or animated demonstration.

name: Written exercise instructions
definition: Step-by-step written instructions for exercises.

name: Target muscles per exercise
definition: Shows the primary and secondary muscles an exercise works.

name: Exercise search and filters
definition: Search the exercise library and filter it by muscle or equipment.

name: Custom exercises
definition: Create your own exercises.

name: Hide, merge or reset exercise data
definition: Hide unwanted library exercises, merge one exercise's history into another, or reset history from a date.

name: Offline exercise videos
definition: Download exercise videos to watch without a connection.

name: Warm-up, stretching and mobility routines
definition: Stretching, mobility or warm-up exercise routines added before or after workouts.

name: In-app tutorials and guided setup
definition: Built-in or official how-to guidance for using the app.

name: Personal records
definition: Personal records are detected automatically, ideally flagged as they happen.

name: Records by rep count
definition: A table of best (and predicted) weights for each rep count.

name: Estimated one-rep max
definition: Estimated 1RM calculated from logged sets.

name: Per-exercise progress charts
definition: Charts of an exercise's weight, 1RM, volume or reps over time.

name: Per-exercise history
definition: A list of every past session of a given exercise.

name: Training volume tracking
definition: Total volume (weight x reps) calculated per workout and over time.

name: Workout frequency and duration trends
definition: Charts of how often and how long you train over time.

name: Sets or volume per muscle group
definition: Stats breaking training down by muscle group.

name: Muscle heatmap
definition: A body diagram shading the muscles trained in a workout or period.

name: Strength score or level
definition: A score or level rating your strength against standards or other users.

name: Weekly, monthly or yearly recaps
definition: Periodic recap reports of your training.

name: Customisable dashboard
definition: Choose which stats, charts or cards appear on a dashboard or home screen.

name: Post-workout summary
definition: A summary screen of the finished workout's stats.

name: Real-world volume comparisons
definition: Total weight lifted expressed as a real-world comparison.

name: Training streaks
definition: A streak of consecutive days or weeks of training (or of meeting a weekly goal).

name: Achievements, badges and levels
definition: Badges, milestones or levels earned for training.

name: Calories burned
definition: Active calories recorded or estimated for workouts.

name: Workouts written to Apple Health
definition: Finished workouts are saved to Apple Health.

name: Import workouts from Apple Health
definition: Workouts recorded by other apps are brought in from Apple Health.

name: Body data synced with Apple Health
definition: Body weight or composition is read from or written to Apple Health.
aspects: Smart scale data via health platforms

name: Body weight log
definition: Log body weight over time with a trend.

name: Body measurements (circumferences, body fat)
definition: Log body measurements beyond weight, such as circumferences or body-fat %.

name: Progress photos
definition: Store private progress photos over time.

name: Calorie and macro logging
definition: Log food calories or macronutrients.

name: Sleep tracking
definition: View sleep (e.g. from Apple Health) or log it.

name: Steps tracking
definition: Steps history in the app.

name: Activity rings in the app
definition: Move/Exercise/Stand rings shown inside the app.

name: Habit and daily-goal tracking
definition: Track daily habits or a combined daily goal, with streaks and reminders.

name: Muscle recovery tracking
definition: Per-muscle recovery or fatigue estimates.

name: Heart rate during workouts
definition: Heart rate recorded and shown during or after a workout.
aspects: Watch heart rate and calories on workouts

name: Heart-rate zones
definition: Time in heart-rate zones for a workout.

name: Cardio exercise logging
definition: Log cardio with distance and/or time.

name: Non-lifting activity types
definition: Track many activity types beyond lifting (sports, yoga, classes, recovery sessions such as sauna).

name: Multi-activity sessions
definition: Chain several activities into one saved session.
aspects: Add an activity to a session

name: GPS outdoor tracking
definition: Track outdoor runs, walks or rides with GPS distance and pace.

name: Route maps
definition: Outdoor workouts show a route map.

name: Swim tracking
definition: Pool laps or open-water swims tracked.

name: Interval and round timers
definition: Timed intervals for HIIT, Tabata, circuits or boxing rounds.

name: Read a cardio machine screen by photo
definition: Photograph a cardio machine's display to import its numbers.

name: Apple Watch app
definition: An Apple Watch app for logging strength workouts.
aspects: Watch rest screen with heart rate
Reply to friends from the watch
Exercise history and notes on watch
Warm-up sets and timers on watch

name: Watch logging without the phone
definition: Log a whole workout on the watch without the iPhone nearby.

name: Start templates or plans on the watch
definition: Start a saved template, routine or today's planned workout from the watch.

name: Live phone-watch sync
definition: The same workout is mirrored live on phone and watch.

name: Edit workout structure on the watch
definition: Add or delete sets, or add, swap or reorder exercises, from the watch.

name: Set types and effort on the watch
definition: Tag set types or rate effort from the watch.

name: Watch complications
definition: App complications or widgets on the watch face.

name: Custom watch faces
definition: App-provided Apple Watch faces.

name: Automatic rep counting
definition: The watch counts reps automatically from motion.

name: Automatic exercise detection
definition: The watch identifies which exercise you are doing (and when sets start and end) from motion alone.
aspects: Detects free-weight, cable, machine and bodyweight exercises
Auto-detection of custom exercises in templates

name: Heart rate from AirPods
definition: Read heart rate from AirPods Pro during workouts.

name: Bluetooth heart-rate monitors
definition: Connect Bluetooth chest straps or other BLE heart-rate monitors.

name: Garmin watch app
definition: An app that runs on Garmin watches to log workouts.

name: Garmin Connect sync
definition: Workouts appear in Garmin Connect.

name: Wear OS app
definition: An app for Wear OS watches.

name: Fitbit integration
definition: Workouts exchanged with Fitbit.

name: Friends or followers
definition: Add friends or follow other users.

name: Activity feed
definition: A feed of the workouts of people you follow or are friends with.

name: Community or discover feed
definition: A feed or community space beyond your own friends.

name: Likes and comments
definition: React to and comment on others' workouts.

name: Customisable profile
definition: A user profile with name, photo or bio.
aspects: Profile photo from contacts or library

name: Privacy controls
definition: Control who can see your activity (private account, per-workout or per-item visibility, hiding from public feeds).

name: Block and report
definition: Block users and report users or content.

name: Follow a friend's workout live
definition: See a friend's workout as it happens.

name: Browse a friend's training
definition: Browse a friend's workout history or schedule.

name: Compare with a friend
definition: Compare your stats or lifts side by side with a specific friend.

name: Leaderboards
definition: Rankings among friends or group members.

name: Groups
definition: Private groups of friends with shared activity.

name: Competitions and challenges
definition: Head-to-head or group competitions over a period.

name: Friend activity notifications
definition: Notifications when friends work out.

name: Tag a workout's gym or location
definition: Attach the gym or location to a workout.

name: Connect your personal trainer
definition: Link to your own personal trainer, who assigns programs and sees your data.

name: Shareable workout images
definition: Generate shareable image cards of workouts or stats.

name: Share to Instagram Stories
definition: Post a workout card directly to Instagram Stories.

name: Workout web links
definition: Share a workout as a web link viewable without the app.

name: Share workouts or templates with others
definition: Send a template, routine, split or workout to someone who can save and do it.
aspects: Share a split with a friend
Send a template to a friend

name: Import history from another app
definition: Import your workout history from another tracker's export.

name: Import a workout from photos, files or links
definition: Turn screenshots, documents, spreadsheets or social-video links into trackable workouts with AI.

name: Data export
definition: Export your workout data to a file.
aspects: Export options for timers and notes

name: Cloud account sync
definition: Data is stored in an account and synced across devices.

name: Strava export
definition: Push finished workouts to Strava.

name: Strava import
definition: Import activities from Strava directly.

name: Health Connect (Android)
definition: Sync with Android Health Connect.

name: Public developer API
definition: A documented API for your own data.

name: Android app
definition: Available on Android via Google Play.

name: Native iPad app
definition: A native iPad build (universal app listed for iPad on the App Store).

name: Web app or dashboard
definition: Use your account's training data in a web browser.

name: Apple Vision Pro compatibility
definition: Listed as compatible with Apple Vision on the App Store.

name: Mac (Apple silicon) availability
definition: Listed as available on Mac on the App Store.

name: Languages other than English
definition: The app is localised into languages other than English.

name: Home and Lock Screen widgets
definition: iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen widgets.

name: Live Activity and Dynamic Island
definition: The live workout appears on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

name: Log sets from the Lock Screen
definition: Complete sets from the Live Activity without unlocking.
aspects: Rest timer controls on lock screen

name: Siri and Shortcuts
definition: Control the app with Siri or the Shortcuts app.

name: Control Center control
definition: A Control Center button for the app.

name: iMessage stickers
definition: A sticker pack for Messages.

name: Distraction blocking during workouts
definition: Block chosen apps while a workout runs.

name: No advertising
definition: The app shows no ads.

name: Dark mode
definition: A dark appearance.

name: Colour themes and accent colours
definition: Choose colour themes or an accent colour.

name: Alternate app icons
definition: Choose an alternate app icon.

name: First day of week setting
definition: Choose the day the week starts.

name: Notification controls and inbox
definition: Per-type notification toggles, or an in-app notification inbox.

name: Sign in with Apple or Google
definition: Sign in with Apple or Google accounts.

name: In-app account deletion
definition: Delete your account and data from inside the app.

name: In-app support and feedback
definition: Contact the team, report bugs or request features from inside the app.

name: AI support assistant
definition: An AI assistant answers support questions.

name: Advice from human coaches
definition: Ask certified trainers or coaches employed by the app for workout advice.
